npcs.name: Wren
npcs.description: A drifter mechanic with a good wrench and bad luck.

npcs.name: Elder Maren
npcs.description: Cinderwell's elder. She remembers when the Foundry sang.

npcs.name: Joss
npcs.description: Runs the general store, and the town's rumor mill.

npcs.name: Doc Hollis
npcs.description: Patches up whoever walks in. Doesn't ask how it happened.

npcs.name: Brannick
npcs.description: Keeps the east gate. Hasn't opened it in a year.

npcs.name: Pip
npcs.description: Ten years old, fearless, and usually in trouble.

npcs.name: Old Teodor
npcs.description: Sweeps ash off the square. Then sweeps it again.

npcs.name: Sella
npcs.description: Hauls water from the cistern for anyone who'll pay.
